provenance.construction: Tile code (Steffan, Choe, Breuckmann, Pereira, Eberhardt, arXiv:2504.09171) with box B = 3 on a 14 x 14 bulk, open boundaries as in the paper; X-tile {h00,h01,h11,h22,v02,v10,v20,v21}, Z-tile by their condition T2: the tile of codes/288-8-15.json and codes/338-8-16.json, here [[512,8,20]]. Reduced to n = 511 by 1 row-space graft, the move @dorakingx introduced on this board (notes/280-8-15.md), at unchanged k, check weight 8 and radius 4; further grafts lost distance under a 2 x 1M-trial RIS check and were rolled back. Surviving qubits keep their single-layer sites on the 45-degree rotated lattice, interaction radius 4.000.
